title: Mediation bus for cross-source token fusion and customer-facing invoice materialization
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Usage events (hosted API, Dedicated pools, Private/VPC ingress) arrive from multiple producers with different schemas, clocks, and duplication semantics. Current reconciliation jobs are brittle: late-arriving events and overlapping attributions create invoice noise and manual adjustments. Goal: build a mediation bus that consumes canonical token events from all sources, performs deterministic fusion/dedupe, applies per-customer rate-translation, and emits a materialized, queryable customer consumption view used by billing and the Console invoice UI.
acceptance_criteria: Mediation bus subscribes to 3 sources (api-ingest, dedicated-meter, private-ingress) and produces unified canonical events into kafka topic 'billing.canonical_events'
Deterministic dedupe: events with same trace_id OR (session_id + seq) are collapsed with idempotent merge rules
Late-arrival handling: events arriving within 72 hours are merged; beyond 72 hours create a 'post-facto adjustment' record that flows into the existing crediting pipeline
Materialized customer_view table is updated within 30s of canonical event emission for 90% of events (SLO), and within 5m for 99%
Console invoice preview uses customer_view and shows stable per-line-unit costs matching monthly expected invoice within ±1% in test dataset
comments: 2026-02-16 - Maya Chen: Kickoff with billing and data-platform. Agreed canonical event schema: event_id, source, customer_id, tenant_scope, model_id, tokens_input, tokens_output, timestamp_us, trace_id, session_id, seq, rate_key, metadata. Added post-facto_adjustment flag for >72h merges.

2026-02-20 - Arjun Patel: Prototype adapter for dedicated-meter that maps NVidia profiler tokens -> canonical tokens. Found issue: profiler uses per-stream batching tags; introduced 'stream_digest' to preserve ordering semantics.

2026-02-25 - Data-platform review (Lina Ortega): Suggested switching from a lambda-based consumer to a Flink job for exactly-once semantics. Trade-off: longer dev time vs stronger guarantees. We opted for Flink due to business risk for invoicing.

2026-03-02 - PM review (Jules Park): Requested visibility for canary rollout: a 'dry-run' path in which mediation bus emits canonical events to a shadow topic and does not update materialized view. We added 'dry_run=true' flag for first-week rollout.

2026-03-05 - Security (Rahul Singh): Asked for KMS envelope encryption on the canonical topic and retention policy audit. Implemented message-level envelope with customer_id hashed in index to avoid PII leakage in logs.

2026-03-09 - Eng update: End-to-end local simulation over 48h dataset shows dedupe rate of 1.8% (expected duplicates from retries) and post-facto-adjustments frequency ~0.6% of events. Observed 95th percentile materialize time 40s; need optimization to hit 30s SLO.

2026-03-10 - Action items: 1) Optimize materialize consumer parallelism (PR open), 2) Add sampling trace to surface long-tail customer with heavy KV-cache misses, 3) Coordinate with billing ops for backfill window and communication plan
